implementation: Builds actual DataDrivenUniformBuffer root metadata from the independently recovered original tree, with ShaderParameterStruct children and retained strings. No global uniform registry insertion or replacement. Original byte size, full member metadata and sorted RHI resource offsets/types are verified before atomic publication. Current metadata and legacy hash remain unchanged.
preflight: Bounds, overlaps, names, numeric/resource shapes, struct sizes, nested depth <=16, expanded nodes <=65536 and total bytes <=65536. Resource arrays, deferred graph resources, referenced uniform buffers and static slots are rejected. Nested inline structures require the Engine patch; their children must be ShaderParameterStruct metadata.
ownership: Owner retains all name/type strings, metadata and nested metadata. Root and parent metadata are destroyed before children. Caller must retain the owner while any RHI uniform buffer references its layout. No resource handles are owned or authenticated.
validation: Source review against FMember, metadata constructor, InitializeLayout and RHI layout behavior. Portable patch reverse-apply check passed against the committed Engine change. No build or runtime execution; deferred to the agreed native checkpoint.
limits: No RHI buffer creation, renderer binding, provider installation, original value producers, resource ownership or visual parity is established. SameUniform output validation is unchanged.
